name: design-review
description: Rule-based acceptance of a frontend delivery against a design hand-off contract. Loads the dev page in a real browser, locates each module via the contract's mapping, extracts computed styles / bounding boxes / text / image sizes, and compares them to the contract with tolerances — outputting an objective findings list (missing modules, wrong size/spacing/font/radius/color, missing copy, distorted images). Not a code diff and not screenshot guessing: rules decide, AI only summarizes.
